description: This file defines the ThingTag class, representing the ID and revision of a 'Thing' in the system. It includes methods to create instances from raw data and JSON objects, and extends an abstract class to handle entity identification with revisions.

classes.name: ThingTag
classes.description: Immutable class representing a combination of a Thing's ID and its revision, with factory methods to create instances from raw data or JSON.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Factory method to create a new ThingTag instance from a ThingId and revision.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates a new ThingTag from a JSON object, extracting necessary fields and handling validation.
